title: Utah-based ecommerce tech company Redo raised an $81M Series B at a $1.25B valuation led by Smash Capital, with participation from Pelion and Cervin (David Politis/Utah Money Watch)
summary: David Politis / Utah Money Watch: Utah-based ecommerce tech company Redo raised an $81M Series B at a $1.25B valuation led by Smash Capital, with participation from Pelion and Cervin — The Utah eCommerce-technology company started with returns. — Now it is raising growth capital to build a broader AI-powered platform …
contentText:
David Politis / Utah Money Watch :

Utah-based ecommerce tech company Redo raised an $81M Series B at a $1.25B valuation led by Smash Capital, with participation from Pelion and Cervin   —  The Utah eCommerce-technology company started with returns.  —  Now it is raising growth capital to build a broader AI-powered platform …
